name: Instrument air / plant compressed air systems (dampers, control valves, actuators)
description: Supply dry, oil-free, particulate-controlled compressed air to pneumatic actuators on dampers and control valves and to instrument/control devices; dryers, filters, separators and receivers condition the air; dew-point sensors monitor dryness at critical points. Seal air for HRSG bypass dampers is a separate but related air system.
